requirements.title: Entregar y recibir el material
requirements.statement: WHEN the encargado marks a reservation as delivered on or after its start date THE system SHALL record the loan, and WHEN he marks it as returned THE system SHALL close the loan, free the units and create a fine of 2 € per day late
